description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the number of factual errors across four different datasets for three distinct question-answering methods. The horizontal category axis displays the datasets in the following order from left to right: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC. The vertical value axis represents the count of factual errors on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 40 with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. A text box labeled "Factual Errors" is positioned in the upper left corner of the chart area. The chart features grouped bars, where each dataset category contains a cluster of three bars representing different methods, as indicated by the legend in the upper right. The methods are visually distinguished by color and pattern: NoR QA is represented by orange bars with a grid pattern, OneR QA by red bars with a dotted pattern, and IRCoT QA by dark blue bars with diagonal stripes. Almost all bars are annotated with their exact numerical values directly above them. For HotpotQA, the values are 15 for NoR QA, 10 for OneR QA, and approximately 5 for IRCoT QA, which is uniquely marked with a small grey rectangle instead of a numerical annotation and represents the shortest bar in the chart. In the 2WikiMQA group, the bars show 29 for NoR QA (the tallest bar in the chart), 23 for OneR QA, and 14 for IRCoT QA. The MuSiQue category displays values of 28 for NoR QA, 27 for OneR QA, and 23 for IRCoT QA. Finally, the IIRC group shows 15 for NoR QA, 14 for OneR QA, and 11 for IRCoT QA. Within every group, the bars are arranged in the same order from left to right, and the values consistently decrease in this order across all four categories, though the categories themselves are not sorted by overall value.
